title: Workplace Cafe Management Program Contract Term and Exit Charges by Service Model
content:
This table fixes, for each service model held under the Workplace Cafe Management Program, the standard initial contract term, the calendar days of notice by which renewal intentions are exchanged before term end, the calendar days of written notice required to terminate the contract, and the number of monthly management fees charged as the early termination fee where the contract ends before the end of its term.

| Service model | Standard initial term (months) | Renewal notice (calendar days before term end) | Termination notice (calendar days) | Early exit charge (months of management fee) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 12 | 60 | 30 | 1 |
| Limited Service Cafe | 24 | 90 | 60 | 2 |
| Full Service Cafe | 36 | 120 | 90 | 3 |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 60 | 180 | 120 | 4 |
| Executive Dining Service | 36 | 120 | 90 | 3 |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 60 | 180 | 180 | 6 |

The initial term lengthens and the notice periods extend moving from the lighter counter-service models toward the larger culinary and commons operations, reflecting the greater mobilization each service model carries; the early exit charge, expressed as a whole number of monthly management fees, rises in step with the initial term except that Executive Dining Service carries the same term, notice periods and exit charge as Full Service Cafe rather than a figure of its own, and Campus Dining Commons Service carries a termination notice period longer than its renewal notice counterpart would otherwise suggest by pattern, at 180 calendar days rather than a shorter figure.

Hypothetically, if a site were held under Culinary Center Cafe, its standard initial term would be read from this table as 60 months, its termination notice as 120 calendar days, and an early exit occurring before the end of that term would be read as attracting a charge of 4 months of the monthly management fee that this table alone fixes for that service model.
